native_context: GitHub App installation-to-customer and repository authority
taxonomy_note: Planning compatibility lens only. Classify the final observed root cause independently; unsupported mappings stay unassigned.

controls.boundary: GitHub App installation-to-customer and repository authority — authoritative consumer
controls.source_trace: Read customer-to-installation mapping, installation token minting, repository selection, requested token permissions and the caller's own account authority.
controls.controlled_verification: With owned local installation fixtures, compare a permitted repository action with a caller-selected installation/repository belonging to another customer. Trace how the service chooses installation identity and narrows the token before the GitHub API operation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A GitHub App installation legitimately has app authority distinct from a user token. A broad app permission alone does not prove one customer can invoke another customer's installation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind caller/customer/installation/repository/action at the service and mint the least required token scope. Retest intended customer operations and the original substituted installation/resource.

coverage_unit: One primary investigative assertion for this technique; not exhaustive coverage. Expand only for genuinely distinct policy/effect assertions in the actual assessment.
